input_integrity: All 108 sealed input hashes verified before inspection; no frozen input modified.
method: For each registered fit, reconstruct seeded JointCell initialization using frozen code and the recorded Torch runtime, independently compare every saved named parameter and its scalar count, then compare actual initial/final L2 to metadata. Gradient maxima and exact finite-graph return curves are training logs, not a rerun of optimization. Frozen tests require exact zero change, not a tolerance.
interpretation: Optimizer-eligible counts are nominal trainable scalars, not functional degrees of freedom. Direct has zero latent-feature columns that stay unchanged.
Continuous reset gradients are zero during mass-weighted pretraining but can be nonzero during unweighted auxiliary regression over unreachable refractory slots; recovery remains inactive.

Freeze labels concern declared raw parameter groups. A frozen normalized reset center can still move in physical coordinates when boundary changes; frozen drive weights still consume a learned content encoder.
Noise is a subset of the dynamics diagnostic group. Do not add their norms or counts.
A finite-graph soft-return gain during training is not held-out utility superiority, a hard-policy result, or a continuous-OU accuracy claim.
Do not subtract two norms relative to initialization and call the result the control-stage parameter-change norm. Only full initial/final tensors were independently compared.
